title: Slovakian-Style Vegan Casserole
description: A hearty, satisfying casserole inspired by Slovakian cuisine, made with plant-based ingredients and no animal products.

ingredients.name: Dense, Slovakian bread (cut into 1-inch cubes)
ingredients.notes: Use a dense, hearty bread for best results

ingredients.name: Amazingly rich vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought or homemade broth for added depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Sautéed mushrooms (such as cremini or shiitake)
Diced bell peppers
ingredients.notes: Any color bell pepper works well

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Add a pop of color and freshness

ingredients.name: Vegan sour cream alternative
ingredients.notes: Choose a store-bought or homemade option

ingredients.name: Slovakian-style paprika
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality paprika for best flavor

instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the mushrooms and bell peppers until tender. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the bread, vegetable broth, sautéed mushrooms and bell peppers, parsley, and vegan sour cream alternative.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot throughout.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
